welcome.title: TabTin
welcome.conceptIntro: In TabTin, a Workspace is a persistent work site bound to an execution device and working directory. It keeps conversations, apps, resources, and execution context together so Agents can help within that boundary.
welcome.loadingDesc: Syncing your organizations and Workspace list
welcome.switchingOrganizationDesc: The current organization is no longer accessible. Switching you to an available one.
welcome.organizationBlockedDesc: Organization "{{name}}" no longer exists or you no longer have access. Please select another organization from the left sidebar.
welcome.readyDesc: Create your first Workspace to get started—or import historical sessions from external Agent tools on this device.
welcome.importAgentHistoryHint: Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and WorkBuddy. Only local indexes are read; no conversation content is uploaded.
welcome.joinedTeamDesc: You're already a member of this organization. There are no Workspaces to open yet; create one here or switch to another organization from the left sidebar.
welcome.createTeamSpace: Create a Workspace in this organization
welcome.moreApps: Plus video, canvas, memos, goals, email and more

guest.subtitleLead: In TabTin, Agents do real work: research online, pull data, build tables, write reports, and make slides.
guest.footnote: Unified access to leading LLMs · 38+ AI work scenarios

schedule.label: Set up a weekly automation task
schedule.detail: Re-runs the whole flow every Monday

demo.reportBody: We tracked 18 funding events this week, concentrated in AI infrastructure, enterprise software, and clean energy. Early rounds (angel to Series A) made up 61%, with a median check of about $3.4M; Series B and beyond skewed sharply toward category leaders. We recommend watching 3 AI Infra startups raising back-to-back rounds — already flagged in the table with investor backgrounds attached.
demo.protection: 4 apps in concert · Re-runs weekly · Checkpoint protected

byokDisclaimer.title: How your own quota works
byokDisclaimer.appliesText: When a model from this channel is selected, Agent replies and same-session compaction use your key and are billed by your provider — not the organization wallet.
byokDisclaimer.complimentaryText: Platform-sponsored — no charge to the organization wallet, regardless of BYOK setup.
byokDisclaimer.platformPaidText: Mail AI, memory, embedding, speech, and similar still use the platform key and are billed from the organization wallet.
byokDisclaimer.noFallbackText: If this channel fails, TabTin does not automatically switch to a platform model.

byokScopeWarning.organization: Organization BYOK: members can select and use models from this channel in chat; platform-managed scenes still use the platform key.
byokScopeWarning.user: Personal BYOK: only you can see and use this channel in any organization; other members are unaffected; platform-managed scenes still use the platform key.

byokBadge.label: BYOK
byokBadge.tooltipOrganization: Organization BYOK channel — used when members select its models in chat; platform-managed scenes still use the platform key.
byokBadge.tooltipUser: Personal BYOK channel — used only when you select its models in any organization; platform-managed scenes still use the platform key.
byokBadge.tooltipGlobal: Platform channel — operated by TabTin for platform-managed scenes and chat when no BYOK model is selected.

minimaxTokenPlan.title: MiniMax Token Plan
minimaxTokenPlan.subtitle: Connect your MiniMax Token Plan subscription. Uses the subscription key (not pay-as-you-go API keys).
minimaxTokenPlan.connectDesc: Enter your Token Plan subscription key. TabTin pre-fills the endpoint and M3 / M2.7 models. M3 has native 1M context; M2.7 models use 256K.
minimaxTokenPlan.apiKeyHint: Get the subscription key under Account → Token Plan. You need an active plan or a team-assigned seat.

dashscopeCodingPlan.title: Bailian Coding Plan
dashscopeCodingPlan.subtitle: Connect Alibaba Cloud Bailian Coding Plan and use your plan quota with the dedicated key.
dashscopeCodingPlan.connectDesc: Enter your Coding Plan key. TabTin pre-fills the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and recommended plan models. Model IDs must match the official whitelist exactly.
dashscopeCodingPlan.apiKeyHint: Get the key on the Coding Plan page (sk-sp- prefix). It does not work with pay-as-you-go keys or dashscope.aliyuncs.com endpoints.

volcengineCodingPlan.title: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan
volcengineCodingPlan.subtitle: Connect Volcengine Ark Coding Plan and use bundled coding models in TabTin.
volcengineCodingPlan.connectDesc: Enter your Ark API key. TabTin pre-fills the Coding Plan OpenAI-compatible endpoint and common code models. Do not use the generic Ark API base URL.
volcengineCodingPlan.apiKeyHint: Get the key in Ark console → API Key management. You must use the coding/v3 endpoint or plan quota will not apply.

zhipuCodingPlan.title: GLM Coding Plan
zhipuCodingPlan.subtitle: Connect Zhipu GLM Coding Plan and use your subscription quota in TabTin.
zhipuCodingPlan.connectDesc: Enter your GLM Coding Plan API key. TabTin pre-fills the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and GLM-5.2 / Turbo / 4.7. GLM-5.2 supports 1M context.
zhipuCodingPlan.apiKeyHint: Create the key under Personal/Team Coding Plan on the Zhipu platform. It is not interchangeable with pay-as-you-go keys.
